name: electron-agent-bridge-monorepo
description: AI-agent control, debugging, automation and testing for any Electron app.

scripts.build: pnpm run gen && tsc -b tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build
scripts.test: pnpm run gen && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && vitest run --project e2e
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run gen && vitest run --project unit --coverage
scripts.gen: node packages/page-agent/scripts/build-agent.mjs && node packages/electron/scripts/build-preload.mjs && node fixtures/app-state/build.mjs && node fixtures/app-components/build.mjs
scripts.check:packages: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run check:package
